name: album
description: One album's page: its photos, rename, cover and removal (owner or write access; never for a dynamic album, whose owner edits its rules instead). Reached by: albums open <id> or albums create <name>.

actions.name: cancel_download
actions.description: Do not download what download.question asks about, as its Cancel button does

actions.name: close_photo
actions.description: Close the viewer. Only while a photo is open (viewing set)

actions.name: confirm_download
actions.description: Download what download.question asks about, as its Download button does

actions.name: delete
actions.description: Delete the album, as More › Delete album then its confirmation does: it goes for everyone it is shared with, its photos stay. The page closes. Owner only

actions.name: download
actions.description: Save loaded photos to this phone, as selecting them and choosing Download does: one photo goes to the photo library, several to one zip (Downloads on Android, the share sheet on iOS). Above 200 MB it asks first (download.question). ls again until download.progress is null

actions.name: edit_rules
actions.description: Open the rule editor (album_rules), as the sliders button does. Owner of a dynamic album only

actions.name: more
actions.description: Load the next page of photos, as scrolling to the end does. Not once complete

actions.name: open
actions.description: Open a loaded photo (by its id in photos) in the viewer. Not while one is open

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Reload the album from its first page, as pulling down does

actions.name: remove
actions.description: Take loaded photos out of the album (they stay in the timeline), as selecting them and Remove does. Owner or write access; with write, only the photos you added go

actions.name: rename
actions.description: Rename the album, as More › Rename does. Owner only

actions.name: retry
actions.description: Try the failed load again, after an error

actions.name: set_cover
actions.description: Make a loaded photo the album's cover, as Set as cover does. Owner only

name.description: The album's name (as opened, until its details arrive)

count.description: Photos in it; null until its details arrive

access.description: What you may do: owner (rename, set the cover, remove, delete), write (remove your own photos) or read; null until its details arrive

sharedBy.description: Who shared it with you; null: your own

dynamic.description: Its photos come from rules (no remove; the owner edits them with edit_rules)

takenAt.description: Capture time on the camera's clock, e.g. 2024-07-14T18:30:05

photos.description: Its photos loaded so far, page by page (more)

complete.description: Every photo of it is loaded

viewing.description: The photo open in the viewer

progress.description: How far the download is, 0 to 1; null when none runs

question.description: A large download waiting for confirm_download or cancel_download, e.g. Download 1.4 GB?

message.description: What the last download did, e.g. Saved to Pictures., or why it failed

download.description: Download (the selection bar's, for every access); null where this page cannot download
